manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Yannik until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
